page_title: WOL 1-3 LIV | Wolves v Liverpool 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The match has just finished.
90+8' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' The substitution is prepared. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed Salah.
90+2' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+2' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+2' The referee shows the yellow card to Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
90+1' 1 - 3 Hugo Bueno (Wolves) scores an unfortunate own goal and the opposition increase their lead!
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Joao Gomes (Wolves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
88' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
87' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
85' 1 - 2 Goal! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes a short pass from Mohamed Salah in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
85' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Jose Sa (Wolves).

85' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
83' Jarell Quansah is substituted due to injury. Jurgen Klopp gives a chance to Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
82' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' That's unlucky! Nelson Semedo (Wolves) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
79' Pedro Neto (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
78' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Mario Lemina will be replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde departs the field of play to be replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
75' The ball rebounds out to Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
71' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
71' The corner kick from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
70' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Jose Sa.
65' Rayan Ait Nouri just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Hugo Bueno (Wolves) replaces him.
64' The game is interrupted now, Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
61' Here comes a substitution. Fabio Silva (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Matheus Cunha.
60' Substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
59' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
56' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) replacing Diogo Jota.
56' Substitution. Cody Gakpo will be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Mohamed Salah. The score is 1:1.
52' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
49' Half-chance! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) plays a pass into the box, but Alisson reacts well to snuff out the attack.

47' What an opportunity! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
46' Half-time substitution. Jurgen Klopp decided to make a change. Alexis Mac Allister is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
45+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar.
43' Mario Lemina (Wolves) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alisson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
41' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.

39' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate at all and the ball went way wide of the right post. What a miss that is!
37' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
32' Craig Dawson (Wolves) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
32' There's an opportunity for Pedro Neto (Wolves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
31' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
29' The corner from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is cleared away by the defence.
29' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

27' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Diogo Jota (Liverpool). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
19' Pedro Neto (Wolves) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
15' Pedro Neto (Wolves) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
14' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) latches onto a short pass from Mohamed Salah inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
11' Wolves are seeing far more of the ball now.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Pedro Neto provides Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
4' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Oliver ignores the protests.
3' A pass from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is intercepted by Jose Sa and the move breaks down.
2' Pedro Neto (Wolves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
2' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Wolves have a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Wolves will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
